Simulate synthetic LTBI diagnostic and TB progression survival data

Source: R/create_fake_data.R
create_fake_data.Rd

Generates synthetic data for Bayesian Multi-Parameter Evidence Synthesis (MPES) linking latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) diagnostic test data and active TB progression time-to-event data. Supports imperfect diagnostic tests (`sens`, `spec`), multiple diagnostic tests per person, linked or unlinked cohorts, test-positive subgroup follow-up, covariates, and prior/data conflict scenarios (`p_ltbi_surv != p_ltbi`).

Usage

create_fake_data(
  N_surv = 500,
  n_survey = c(1000),
  p_ltbi = 0.3,
  p_ltbi_surv = NULL,
  sens = 0.85,
  spec = 0.95,
  surv_dist = c("gompertz", "weibull", "exponential"),
  shape = 0.1,
  rate = 0.1,
  t_censor = 10,
  cohort_type = c("all", "pos_only"),
  include_covariates = FALSE,
  beta_cov = c(0.4, 0.6),
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

N_surv

Integer. Sample size of the progression survival cohort (before any `pos_only` filtering). Default is `500`.

n_survey

Integer vector. Sample sizes of aggregate LTBI prevalence surveys. Default is `c(1000)`.

p_ltbi

Numeric in `(0, 1)`. True baseline LTBI prevalence in the diagnostic survey population. Default is `0.30`.

p_ltbi_surv

Numeric in `(0, 1)` or `NULL`. True baseline LTBI prevalence in the progression survival cohort. Defaults to `p_ltbi` (no conflict). Set to a different value (e.g., `0.60`) to simulate selection bias / conflict between the survey and survival modules.

sens

Numeric vector in `(0, 1]`. Sensitivity of each diagnostic test `k = 1, ..., K`. Default is `0.85`.

spec

Numeric vector in `(0, 1]`. Specificity of each diagnostic test `k = 1, ..., K`. Default is `0.95`.

surv_dist

Character. Parametric survival distribution for uncured progression times: `"gompertz"`, `"weibull"`, or `"exponential"`.

shape

Numeric. Shape parameter for `"gompertz"` (can be real) or `"weibull"` (must be positive). Ignored for `"exponential"`. Default `0.1`.

rate

Numeric (`> 0`). Hazard rate / scale parameter `lambda`. Default `0.1`.

t_censor

Numeric (`> 0`). Maximum administrative follow-up / censoring time. Default is `10`.

cohort_type

Character. Either `"all"` (all screened individuals are followed for active TB progression) or `"pos_only"` (only individuals testing positive on test 1 are followed for progression, so false positives are cured and the effective uncured fraction is the positive predictive value, PPV).

include_covariates

Logical. If `TRUE`, simulates two baseline covariates (`age_z` and `high_inc_origin`) affecting `logit(p_ltbi)`.

beta_cov

Numeric vector of length 2 used when `include_covariates = TRUE`. Default is `c(0.4, 0.6)`.

seed

Optional integer random seed for reproducibility.

Value

A list with components:

`progression_data`

Tibble of individual-level survival follow-up (`t`, `d`, `z_true`, test results `x1`, ..., and optional covariates).

`prevalence_data`

Tibble of aggregate binomial survey data (`y`, `n`, `test_id`) plus normal logit plug-in summaries (`mu_hat`, `sigma_hat`).

`diagnostic_ipd`

Tibble of individual-level test results (`x1`, ...) for the progression cohort.

`truth`

List of true data-generating parameters (`p_ltbi`, `p_ltbi_surv`, `sens`, `spec`, `ppv_surv`, `surv_dist`, `shape`, `rate`, `cohort_type`).
